descriptions.preferred: This plant is quite similar to 'Shinobuga oka', except that it is more pendulous in habit and rarely grows taller than 2. 5 m. The branches tend to droop and give a round bush effect, in contrast to the other members of the Linearilobum Group which tend to be upright. The deep green leaves are mostly seven lobed. The lobes are very long and narrow like a blade of grass, and about 3-5 mm wide and up to 8 cm long. They turn yellow in the fall, sometimes to a deep gold. Japan as

rhs.description: A deciduous, upright Japanese maple, about 3-4m tall, of twiggy growth, with long slender usually 5-lobed bright but dark green leaves, sometimes 3 or 7 lobes to 9cm long, holds its colour through spring and summer then turns yellow in autumn; suited to bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、直立型日本枫，株高约 3–4 米，枝条细密。 叶片细长，通常为 5 裂，色泽明亮而偏深绿，有时为 3 裂或 7 裂，叶长可达 9 厘米；春夏季能较好保持叶色，秋季转黄。 适合做盆景培养。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种与 ‘Shinobuga oka’ 十分相似，但株形更为下垂，且高度很少超过 2. 5 米。 枝条倾向下垂，形成圆拱形灌丛效果；这与 Linearilobum Group 其他通常较直立的成员形成对比。 叶片深绿色，多为七裂。 裂片极长而狭，形如草叶，宽约 3–5 毫米，长可达 8 厘米。 秋季转黄，有时呈深金黄色。 在日本称作 ‘Ao meshime-no-uchi shidare’。
